questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The library has ______ rooms than it needs.
questions.explanation: rooms 是可数名词复数，比较级用 fewer。less 修饰不可数名词。
questions.evidence: We have fewer rooms than we need.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: ______ people came to the talk than last time.
questions.explanation: people 是可数名词复数，比较级用 Fewer。
questions.evidence: Fewer people came to the talk than last time.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The programme offers ______ events every month.
questions.explanation: events 是可数名词复数，用 many 修饰。much 和 a little 修饰不可数名词。
questions.evidence: The programme offers many events every month.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The library provides ______ information about each talk.
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词，用 much 修饰。many, few, several 修饰可数名词。
questions.evidence: The library provides much information about each talk.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct pronoun: The volunteers help visitors. ______ answer questions.
questions.explanation: volunteers 是复数，指代用 They。
questions.evidence: The volunteers help visitors. They answer questions.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct article: Dr. Chen is ______ expert in science education.
questions.explanation: expert 以元音音素开头，泛指一位专家用 an。
questions.evidence: Dr. Chen is an expert in science education.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct verb: The library ______ live captions on screens.
questions.explanation: 主语 The library 是单数第三人称，一般现在时动词加 -s，用 provides。
questions.evidence: The library provides live captions on screens.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct verb: The volunteers ______ at tables after each talk.
questions.explanation: 主语 The volunteers 是复数，一般现在时用动词原形 sit。
questions.evidence: The volunteers sit at tables after each talk.

title: The Open Archive: How a City Library Makes Expertise Accessible · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点：1) 比较结构：more than, fewer than, as...as, not as...as。例如 'more than forty events' 表示“超过四十场”。2) 数量表达：many, much, a few, a little, several, plenty of。注意 many 修饰可数名词，much 修饰不可数名词。3) 指代：it, they, them, their 要明确指代前文的名词。4) 冠词：a/an 用于泛指单数可数名词，the 用于特指或已提到的事物。5) 主谓一致：主语和谓语在人称和数上一致。例如 'The library provides'（单数），'Volunteers sit'（复数）。

Now it offers more than forty events each month.
